landing.eyebrow: Gateway for the official Codex app-server
landing.title: Use remote Codex from the browser
landing.lead: Codex Gateway is a web frontend and connection gateway for the official Codex app-server. It is not another Codex implementation, and it does not run an agent runtime in the browser. The browser talks only to Gateway; SSH credentials and the Codex runtime stay on the server.
landing.ctaHint: Use the account created by an administrator to open the workspace
landing.how1Body: Unauthenticated visits to the home page see this intro first, then continue to sign-in.
landing.how2Body: Use the account issued by an administrator. Connection config is encrypted on the server and is not stored in the browser.
landing.how3Body: Manage multiple SSH hosts, project directories, and Codex threads from one UI.
landing.featureOfficialBody: Render app-server threads, events, approvals, and file changes instead of inventing a parallel protocol.
landing.featureHostsBody: Manage multiple SSH hosts, projects, and threads from a single browser workspace.
landing.featureCredentialsBody: SSH passwords, private keys, and Codex tokens stay on Gateway. The browser only holds a Gateway session.
landing.featureShareBody: Each host keeps one gateway-side SSH and app-server connection, reused across browser tabs.
landing.featureRecoverBody: After a refresh, app-server restart, or brief SSH drop, Gateway realigns and restores thread state.
landing.featureOpsBody: Open an SSH terminal beside the agent, preview private remote web apps, and watch tmux, CPU/GPU, and host metrics.
landing.footer: Codex Gateway connects to the official app-server. It does not reimplement Codex.
